description: This PHP source file provides utility functions related to UI components, such as generating validation scripts and HTML forms for campaign records in SuiteCRM. It is involved in rendering parts of the campaign entry forms and validation logic.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: A utility class used to generate JavaScript validation code for forms.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of form data, specifically checking for missing required fields.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for creating a new campaign record, including assigning values, options, and JavaScript for validation.
